Oliver Chen: Quick sync — hitting a weird combo of issues when running the embed batcher across py and go SDKs: dims mismatch errors, occasional 401 after retry, and streaming partials being dropped. Anyone run into this today?
Maya Patel: saw a dim mismatch once yesterday, looked transient. can you paste minimal repro? :thinking_face:
Oliver Chen: repro below (py):
```python
# simple batcher loop
from redwood import EmbeddingsClient
cli = EmbeddingsClient(token=os.getenv('RW_TOKEN'))
batches = chunk(items, 32)
for b in batches:
    resp = cli.embed(b)
    # sometimes error: ValueError: expected 1536, got 1534
```
Chen Li: what SDK version? we had a bug where Go pad logic dropped 2 dims when using float16 quantized vectors + pad_to_multiple flag.
Oliver Chen: py sdk 0.9.2, go sdk 0.8.7. the go one retries on 5xx/401 and we sometimes see a 401 followed by a successful call but the batcher still logs mismatch.
Lucas Rivera: quick ask — are you using prefix caching or KV cache reuse between requests? that can change shapes if slicing goes wrong.
Oliver Chen: using prefix caching on the runner. suspect race: go retry resends a smaller sub-batch after partial failure and our reassembly assumes original order.
Carla Gomez: can you paste the exact error text? helps triage.
Oliver Chen: here —
```
ERROR: embedding_service: batch_processor.go:123: dims mismatch: expected=1536 actual=1534 (request id=abc-123)
WARN: auth: token refresh triggered after 401 for req abc-124
DEBUG: retry: resend batch id=42 chunk_idx=1 size=16
```
Maya Patel: hmm token refresh on 401 could happen mid-batch. If the SDK retries only the remainder it might reduce shape. Suggest setting SDK_RETRY_MODE=full to resend entire batch, or make retries idempotent at transport layer.
Chen Li: filed a small reproducer — found that streaming endpoints were sending a final close frame before the server finished flushing partials. Go client interpreted that as EOF and returned partial embeddings array.
Oliver Chen: so combined failure scenario: 401 -> token refresh -> go client retries remainder -> server streams partials + early close -> client assembles shorter vector -> dims mismatch.
Lucas Rivera: ok patch idea: (1) make retries resend whole batch when Authorization header changes (2) assert length of vectors on client side and force full retry on mismatch (3) improve streaming read to wait for explicit end marker.
Carla Gomez: +1. also add guard in batch helper: pad vectors to target_dim with zeros and emit a warning instead of hard crash. config=EMB_PAD_STRATEGY=zero|truncate
dev-bot: CI pipeline started for branch oliver/embed-retry-fix (build #4821) :rocket:
Oliver Chen: will open PR with above fixes, unit tests + tiny e2e. pinging reviewers @Lucas Rivera @Maya Patel for quick review.
Maya Patel: can review tomorrow morning. small note — pad/zeroing can hide upstream dataset issues, so add telemetry when padding happens.
Lucas Rivera: also update docs for go client: recommend SDK_RETRY_MODE=full for non-idempotent batch endpoints and call out streaming quirks.
Chen Li: repurposed a small test to simulate token rotation and partial stream close — pushed to the repo under test/embed/repro. results reproduce reliably with go sdk 0.8.7.
Oliver Chen: thanks all — timeline: I’ll push PR today, run CI, then deploy to staging. I’ll post here when staging run passes.
Carla Gomez: can you also add a migration guide for teams using older SDKs so they don't get silent padding?
Oliver Chen: yep — will include a short note in the PR and add a health-check that fails if >1% of embeddings are padded.
dev-bot: build #4821 succeeded (tests: 1225, failures: 0) — merging in 5m.
Oliver Chen: merged. staging deploy in progress. will follow up with perf numbers after a couple hours. :thumbsup:
